## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 32. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke opens by saying that of all the Power Four hires, this is the hardest one to project in his estimation. He credits the record — a four-year run at Toledo he calls great and a decade in Ames he calls tremendous, built up amid a lot of financial and reputational shortcomings in a high-octane offensive conference — then sets the scale against it: Penn State is a different beast, and this is a BIG job. He identifies two assets: Campbell's strong Ohio ties, which should help with recruiting, and the hire of D'Anton Lynn, a Texas native, as defensive coordinator, giving Penn State connections from coast to coast. His closing frame is what stood out at Iowa State — how Campbell maximized the talent he was able to recruit — and the question that follows: with more fertile recruiting grounds, what can he do with more talent? He answers that this will be the big question, and maybe one not quite answered in 2026.
